newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar closes on highs on good two-way trade.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar closes on highs on good two-way trade.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed on its highs on Friday, with dealers reporting good two-way trade above US$0.70.
The Kiwi closed at 0.7011/18 while on the Trade Weighted Index it was up 30 points on the day at 66.76.
One dealer said the New York market was long overnight and the Kiwi had been bid at 0.6990 and pushed down to a 0.6975 low in the first couple of hours of trading.
At that level "quite a bit of volume went through. It ground higher all afternoon with a high of 0.7015," the dealer said. "Trade was very two-way expecially above the figure."

He said he expected the Kiwi to trend slightly higher overnight, but with the currency reaching a previous high of 0.7027 it would face resistance above that level, "with 0.7030/35 a tough nut to crack first up".
"I think it will be bid around the 0.6990 area on any dip back down again," he said.
